sources.entry: asciinema - Web app for hosting asciicasts. (Demo, Source Code) Apache-2.0 Elixir/Docker

summary.one_liner: A self-hostable web server for hosting, sharing, and live-streaming terminal session recordings in asciicast format, built with Elixir and Phoenix.
summary.what_it_does: The server hosts terminal session recordings in asciicast format and provides live streaming of terminal sessions. It offers a web interface for viewing, browsing, sharing, and managing recordings and streams, plus an HTTP API used by the asciinema CLI. Recordings can be set to private, unlisted, or public visibility and shared via secret links or embedded player. Full-text search covers titles, descriptions, and terminal session content. Metadata such as title and Markdown description can be edited, and plain text transcripts (.txt) can be downloaded. The server embeds asciinema's avt virtual terminal for preview generation, recording analysis, and live stream state.
use_cases: share a terminal demo with a link
embed a terminal player in a web page
search past recordings by their terminal content
notable: Embeds asciinema's avt virtual terminal for previews, analysis, and live stream state
Full-text search over recording titles, descriptions, and full terminal session content
Works with the asciinema CLI through an HTTP API
Visibility control: private, unlisted, or public, with secret-link sharing
Privacy-focused: no tracking and no ads, per the README
caveats: Requires a running PostgreSQL server and a toolchain of Elixir 1.19+, Erlang/OTP 28+, Node.js, and Rust unless using the Nix dev shell
README covers development setup only; self-hosting deployment details are referred to external docs and were not in the README
asciinema.org is the project's hosted public instance; self-hosting is an option, not the default
